hero.headline: Concerts, graduations, events and portraits.
hero.intro: I'm Rick Mongia, a photographer and videographer working across New Jersey, New York City and the Seattle area. I make images that hold up printed large and look right on your feed.
hero.note: Based in New Brunswick, NJ. Shooting since 2022.

services.title: Events
services.text: Parties, concerts, school events and corporate functions, documented start to finish in photo and video.

services.title: Portraits and headshots
services.text: Headshots, personal portraits and LinkedIn photos for students, professionals and creators.

services.title: Real estate
services.text: Listing photos and video for homes, Airbnbs, commercial spaces and architecture.

services.title: Graduations and seniors
services.text: Graduation photos, senior portraits and ceremonies in New Jersey, NYC and the Pacific Northwest.

services.title: Weddings and engagements
services.text: Engagement sessions through full wedding days, with photo and video coverage.

services.title: Social media content
services.text: Photos and short-form video for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube, for creators and businesses.

services.title: Product and commercial
services.text: Product, food and commercial photography that shows off your menu, storefront or catalog.

services.title: Lifestyle and family
services.text: Family, maternity, newborn and pet sessions that stay relaxed from start to finish.

about.heading: Behind the camera
paragraphs: I'm a student at Rutgers University, splitting my time between New Jersey and Washington State. I started taking photos in middle school and launched Mongia Media to give people affordable, high-quality photo and video they can count on.
I specialize in portrait, real estate, event and street photography, plus videography, and I'm always open to travel for the right project.
Off the clock I'm playing guitar and bass, exploring new places, or spending time with family and friends.
about.areas: New Jersey, New York City, Seattle and the PNW. Available to travel.
